Definition: from G4314 and G5021; to arrange towards, i.e. (figuratively) enjoin:--bid, command.
BiblicalUsage: Prostasso means to command, to enjoin, to arrange toward. Jesus told the cleansed leper to show himself to the priest and offer the gift that Moses commanded, Peter commanded the household of Cornelius to be baptized, and Joseph did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a command from the Lord is not a suggestion: the leper went, the household was baptized, and Joseph obeyed in the night.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; Simon Peter; Joseph, Husband of Mary
